review_note: Reconciled against data/raw and the live scripts. Entries for datasets that were selected on paper but never downloaded or read were moved to evaluated_not_used. PlantZAfrica moved from deferred to selection: it is now a primary source for 1,774 of 2,843 species, and its licensing is an open legal-review item rather than a settled permission.

selection.name: Foliar Trait and Spectroscopy Data, Greater Cape Floristic Region, South Africa
selection.license: Openly shared without restriction on ORNL DAAC; companion repository is GPL-3.0
selection.use: Maximum height, growth form, life history, flowering and measured height/canopy axes for GCFR plants.
selection.limitation: Field measurements are not horticultural mature dimensions. In the shipped catalogue only 212 of 2,843 spread values are original measurements; the rest are imputed and carry spread_source/spread_confidence.

selection.name: BioSCape GCFR occurrence records, filtered to the Western Cape
selection.use: Evidence that a taxon is recorded in the Western Cape; occurrence counts and the coordinates used to assign biome and bioregion.
selection.limitation: The regional filter was applied before the file entered the repository, so that step is not reproducible from these scripts. Occurrence proves a record, not garden suitability.

selection.name: PlantZAfrica horticultural profiles (SANBI)
selection.license: UNRESOLVED - no official bulk export or reusable bulk-data licence has been identified. Treat as a legal-review item before any public release beyond this MVP.
selection.use: Light, water, soil, plant type, flower colour, special features, care notes and photographs. The primary source for 1,774 of 2,843 species; a further 304 combine it with BioSCape.
selection.limitation: Profiles are editorial horticultural writing, not a structured trait database: fields were parsed from prose, coverage varies (special features 71%), and absence of a flag is not a negative test. Photographs are hotlinked to pza.sanbi.org with attribution, not redistributed.
selection.photo_licence_note: UNVERIFIED: generate_plants_json.py stamps CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 on all 2,066 PlantZAfrica photos, citing this file. That licence is what BGIS applies to its spatial datasets; no PlantZAfrica photo licence has actually been confirmed. Either verify it or stop asserting a specific licence.

selection.name: iNaturalist observation photographs
selection.license: Per contributor, recorded per plant: cc-by-nc (391), cc-by-sa (256), cc-by (35), cc0 (17), cc-by-nc-sa (15), cc-by-nc-nd (5)
selection.use: Fallback plant photograph for the 762 species with no PlantZAfrica image; 15 species still have none.
selection.limitation: Terms differ per photograph, so they cannot be treated as one licence. 396 are non-commercial and 5 are no-derivatives, which constrains reuse of the plan images. Each record carries photo_attribution and photo_license and both must stay displayed.

selection.name: SANBI National Vegetation Map 2018 - Western Cape clip
selection.license: Source/copyright SANBI; BGIS datasets use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
selection.use: Map a garden location and a plant occurrence to vegetation type, biome and bioregion.
selection.limitation: This is the public Western Cape 2018 clip. SANBI's 2024 national vegetation map is newer and should replace it when a suitable full download/hosting strategy is chosen. Only 23% of catalogue species have a bioregion from an occurrence; the rest are matched at biome level.

selection.name: Western Cape place names (provincial and national ArcGIS services)
selection.license: Provincial/national government spatial services; terms not individually recorded - confirm before redistribution.
selection.use: The town and suburb list behind the location question: 1,597 places, each carrying its biome and bioregion.
selection.limitation: 1,669 source rows reduce to 1,597 after non-residential names and duplicates are removed. Places on or outside a bioregion boundary are assigned by majority or nearest polygon and are flagged in bioregion_source.

selection.name: Alien and invasive taxa list (Darwin Core export)
selection.license: Not recorded at import - confirm against its publisher before relying on it legally.
selection.use: The anti-join that removed invasive species from the catalogue before it was finalised.
selection.limitation: The exclusion is baked into the shipped catalogue and is no longer re-run. The file's exact provenance was not recorded at import; it resembles the SANBI alien-taxa checklist rather than the gazetted NEMBA list.

selection.name: NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species List (Government Notice 1003)
selection.use: Authoritative legal reference for the Stage 0 F4 exclusion.
selection.limitation: PARTLY CLOSED (2026-09-24): app/data/nemba_exclusions.json is no longer empty - it now holds 1,077 binomials built from invasive-plants-list by data/scripts/build_nemba_exclusions.py, so F4 is a live second check and a test asserts no catalogue species is listed. REMAINING GAP: that is an alien-taxa checklist, not the gazetted notice, so the legal list itself is still not transcribed and the two may differ.

selection.name: FINAL.DATASET.FINAL.xlsx (owner-curated catalogue)
selection.license: Derived work - inherits the terms of every source above
selection.raw_path: kept beside the repository, not in version control; path overridable with FINAL_DATASET_PATH
selection.use: The single source of the species catalogue: 2,843 species, 47 columns, imported and hashed on every dev and build.
selection.limitation: Not a raw source. It merges the sources above with manual curation and imputation; every derived field carries its own *_source and *_confidence column, and those must stay visible in the interface.

evaluated_not_used.name: South African National Plant Checklist
evaluated_not_used.reason: Selected in the July 2026 pass but never downloaded into data/raw, and no live script reads it. Names in the catalogue come from BioSCape and PlantZAfrica as recorded, without checklist reconciliation.
evaluated_not_used.consequence: The catalogue has no synonym table, so nursery name matching falls back to cultivar, hybrid and common-name tiers. This is the source to add if synonym handling is needed.

evaluated_not_used.name: Botanical Database of Southern Africa (BODATSA): Botanical Collections
evaluated_not_used.license: CC BY 4.0 on GBIF/IPT; POSA separately displays CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
evaluated_not_used.reason: Selected in the July 2026 pass but never downloaded into data/raw, and no live script reads it. Occurrence counts shown in the app come from bioscape-gcfr-occurrences.
evaluated_not_used.consequence: Interface copy that credited BODATSA for occurrence records was corrected on 2026-09-24.

evaluated_not_used.name: A list of alien taxa for South Africa
evaluated_not_used.reason: Not present at the recorded raw_path. It may be the origin of data/raw/InvasivePlants.txt, but that was not recorded at import and has not been confirmed.
evaluated_not_used.consequence: Confirming this would settle the licence and provenance of the invasive-species exclusion.

deferred.name: SANBI Red List
deferred.reason: Use as the conservation-status authority, but no bulk download was found during this pass. Do not infer threat status from occurrence frequency.

deferred.name: Reviewed horticultural tolerances and nursery spacing
deferred.reason: PlantZAfrica now supplies light, water and soil for most species, but as parsed editorial text rather than a reviewed trait dataset, and mature spread remains largely imputed. A horticulturist's review is still the outstanding requirement before any claim of growing advice.
